description: The caller contract: for each answer from an agent or from controld's resolve, what a client library does by itself. Generated from mansio-server's front.Contract (go test ./internal/front -run TestContractFiles -update); do not edit.

vectors.name: agent: ok
vectors.why: done (duplicate=true: this request_id was applied before; count is the original's)
vectors.meaning: done (duplicate=true: this request_id was applied before; count is the original's)

vectors.name: agent: shed
vectors.why: nothing ran; retry after Retry-After with backoff and jitter
vectors.meaning: nothing ran; retry after Retry-After with backoff and jitter

vectors.name: agent: unavailable
vectors.why: nothing ran; a dependency is down or recovering: retry after Retry-After with backoff and jitter
vectors.meaning: nothing ran; a dependency is down or recovering: retry after Retry-After with backoff and jitter

vectors.name: agent: expired
vectors.why: the deadline is spent, so a client library does not retry it; the caller may, with a fresh deadline (ambiguous=true: a write may have committed, keep the same request_id)
vectors.meaning: the deadline is spent, so a client library does not retry it; the caller may, with a fresh deadline (ambiguous=true: a write may have committed, keep the same request_id)

vectors.name: agent: stmt_timeout
vectors.why: nothing changed; do not retry unchanged (the statement is too slow for the limit)
vectors.meaning: nothing changed; do not retry unchanged (the statement is too slow for the limit)

vectors.name: agent: aborted
vectors.why: nothing changed; safe to retry at once
vectors.meaning: nothing changed; safe to retry at once

vectors.name: agent: wrong_owner
vectors.why: re-resolve the database (locator), then retry with the new ticket
vectors.meaning: re-resolve the database (locator), then retry with the new ticket

vectors.name: agent: fenced
vectors.why: re-resolve after Retry-After; the database is moving or suspended
vectors.meaning: re-resolve after Retry-After; the database is moving or suspended

vectors.name: agent: ticket_invalid
vectors.why: get a new ticket, then retry
vectors.meaning: get a new ticket, then retry

vectors.name: agent: bad_request
vectors.why: fix the request; retrying it unchanged fails again
vectors.meaning: fix the request; retrying it unchanged fails again

vectors.name: agent: internal
vectors.why: report the log_id; a write may or may not have committed: the caller may retry with the same request_id
vectors.meaning: report the log_id; a write may or may not have committed: the caller may retry with the same request_id

vectors.name: agent: transport
vectors.why: no answer (connect failure, reset, unreadable body): the VM may be gone; a write may have committed, so it is retried with the same request id
vectors.meaning: no answer (connect failure, reset, unreadable body): the VM may be gone; a write may have committed, so it is retried with the same request id

vectors.name: resolve: ok
vectors.why: a route and a ticket
vectors.meaning: a route and a ticket

vectors.name: resolve: moving
vectors.why: the database is moving or being created: resolve again after Retry-After (controld paces the client, so this reroute is not charged)
vectors.meaning: the database is moving or being created: resolve again after Retry-After (controld paces the client, so this reroute is not charged)

vectors.name: resolve: shed
vectors.why: controld refused the load (source rate limit, store reads or creates in flight); nothing ran
vectors.meaning: controld refused the load (source rate limit, store reads or creates in flight); nothing ran

vectors.name: resolve: unavailable
vectors.why: Postgres or an agent cannot do it now, or too many calls in flight
vectors.meaning: Postgres or an agent cannot do it now, or too many calls in flight

vectors.name: resolve: no_capacity
vectors.why: no live vm under the placement caps right now
vectors.meaning: no live vm under the placement caps right now

vectors.name: resolve: timeout
vectors.why: the resolve deadline passed
vectors.meaning: the resolve deadline passed

vectors.name: resolve: transport
vectors.why: no answer from controld
vectors.meaning: no answer from controld

vectors.name: resolve: bad_request
vectors.why: malformed request
vectors.meaning: malformed request

vectors.name: resolve: unauthorized
vectors.why: unknown, malformed or revoked credential
vectors.meaning: unknown, malformed or revoked credential

vectors.name: resolve: forbidden
vectors.why: the credential belongs to another tenant
vectors.meaning: the credential belongs to another tenant

vectors.name: resolve: not_found
vectors.why: no such database
vectors.meaning: no such database

vectors.name: resolve: suspended
vectors.why: the database is suspended
vectors.meaning: the database is suspended

vectors.name: resolve: conflict
vectors.why: not allowed in the database's or tenant's state
vectors.meaning: not allowed in the database's or tenant's state

vectors.name: resolve: quota_exceeded
vectors.why: create on first use past a cap: a quota, not an overload, so retrying cannot help
vectors.meaning: create on first use past a cap: a quota, not an overload, so retrying cannot help

vectors.name: resolve: internal
vectors.why: a bug; report the log_id
vectors.meaning: a bug; report the log_id
